items.difficulty_reason: Associativity of derived tensor products over a chain of dg algebras: resolves the first factor by a good module P (lemma-resolve) so the underived tensors compute the derived ones, rearranges P tensor_A (N tensor_{A'} N'), and compares the two pairings through the tensor-symmetry lemma, with the author noting the reader may repeat the earlier argument in place. Retained author proof at lines 5032-5082.
